clusters.title: I gave each Docker container its own Tailscale address, and stopped exposing ports on my home server
I replaced Todoist, Toggl, and my Pomodoro timer with one free app that does it all

xda.author: Abhishek Kumar Mishra
xda.body:
I gave each Docker container its own Tailscale address, and stopped exposing ports on my home server
Docker is a fantastic tool to isolate your self-hosted tools from each other and maintain a robust, fail-proof home server. The traditional way to access the web portal of any container is via its published port. Each port number is a direct gateway to access the portal, but it gets tedious after a point. You have to be careful with the port number assignment and also need to remember them. Exposing ports is something that we rarely pay attention to, and it slowly becomes complex.

xda.author: Parth Shah
xda.body:
I replaced Todoist, Toggl, and my Pomodoro timer with one free app that does it all
My productivity setup had become unnecessarily complicated. I relied on Todoist to manage my daily tasks, Toggl to track how much time I spent on individual projects, and a separate Pomodoro timer to maintain focus throughout the day.
